messages:
maria (PM): Quick sync — I put together a proposal for "capacity-safeguard" defaults for Dedicated beta. High level: soft reclaim at 80% per-pool, hard reclaim at 95% with a short eviction window, automatic spillover to burst tier with a surcharge. Need input on defaults, edge cases (stateful sessions, KV cache), and launch criteria. @sam (Eng-Platform) @jordan (SRE) PTAL

sam (Eng-Platform): Thanks — couple quick Qs: how do grace tokens work across long-lived sessions? And do we throttle or evict?

maria (PM): Grace tokens are per-tenant, per-pool. Idea: a small credit bucket that absorbs brief spikes (defaults: 5 tokens per-minute per-tenant) before soft reclaim kicks in. Soft reclaim = throttling & deprioritization; hard reclaim = eviction of opportunistic jobs.

jordan (SRE): Hard reclaim at 95% + 10s window feels aggressive for large-seq workloads. KV cache thrash could cause latency blips. Recommend soft_reclaim=78, hard_reclaim=93, and a staggered eviction that targets non-persistent/low-priority jobs first.

liam (Sales): Heads up — FinCorp and Acme asked for an exception: no evictions <90% for their reserved pools (they paid for headroom). Can we support per-customer SLA overrides?

sam (Eng-Platform): We can support per-customer overrides but it reduces available headroom for others. Implementation: per-pool priority bands + reserve percentage. Example bands: platinum: reserve 12% headroom, gold: 8%, standard: 4%. Overrides gated by commit size and pricing.

maria (PM): Proposed priority factor model (for allocation algorithm): platinum=1.0, gold=0.7, standard=0.45. Also add predictive headroom where we reserve extra N% based on 95th pct usage historical. This helps burst stability.

jordan (SRE): Agree on predictive headroom. Also need telemetry: per-pool eviction_rate, reclaim_events, and KV_cache_miss_rate. Alerting: page SRE if eviction_rate > 0.5% sustained over 5m.

sam (Eng-Platform): Draft config snippet for staging test:
```yaml
pool_defaults:
  soft_reclaim_pct: 78
  hard_reclaim_pct: 93
  eviction_window_s: 15
  grace_tokens_per_min: 5
  burst_surcharge_per_1k_tokens: "$0.80"
  priority_bands:
    platinum: 1.0
    gold: 0.7
    standard: 0.45
```

maria (PM): Nice. For launch criteria I propose: 
- Canary run with 5 diverse tenants for 72h with no >1% customer-impacting evictions
- Telemetry: eviction_events, tail latency P95/P99, KV cache miss delta, cost delta reported daily
- Rollback policy + automatic fallback to previous model variant if eviction spike >2% in 10m
- Product signoff and 2-week customer comms plan

jordan (SRE): Add chaos test: synthetic spike that pushes to 110% for 10m to validate spillover and fallback. Also simulate network partition to verify no cross-pool bleed.

liam (Sales): I'll flag FinCorp/Acme asks and draft SLA exception templates. We should price the override (premium + commit).

sam (Eng-Platform): Implementation plan: prototype reclaim controller in staging this week, run 72h canary next Tue, integrate metrics into Console (per-route eviction heatmap) by next Friday. I can drive.

maria (PM): Action items: 
- sam: prototype + canary schedule (ETA next Tue)
- jordan: run chaos + eviction sim, add alerts (ETA Fri)
- liam: SLA exception drafts + pricing options (ETA Wed)
- maria: update spec doc and canary invite list (ETA Mon)

devops-bot: Deploy pipeline triggered for branch capacity-safeguard/staging (build #472). :rocket:

maria (PM): Thanks all — want an engineering + SRE signoff by Mon so we can plan the canary. If no objections by EOD Friday I'll lock defaults to what's in the snippet and start comms. :white_check_mark:
